items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: The interviewee discusses playing in bands and mentions various musicians (Eddie, Closito, 'the fat man'), but the name 'Tommy' is only introduced by the interviewer in a question ('Tell me something Tommy') without the interviewee confirming a personal relationship or interaction with a specific pe

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Now you see look, I played at the Dixieland Hall at Santa before last. Well I played in that with them fellas, well what you call it, he played trombone with it before, you know, Eddie. Well I know Eddie. And well I didn't play with Closito, I know him, you see. But the mother boys, I didn't know nothing but them fellas, you see. But you know what I mean? That time was bad. See look, you could feel it, you know what I mean? You know what I mean? When you're supposed to play a little more faster, time…

about? Tell me something Tommy. You know, I know you like to play for people dancing rather than listening. I know you told me that many times. Sure, yeah, quite. Sure. You know also the tempos, you play different tempos for dancing, not waltzes, I mean if you play just any kind of numbers.

No, you see, look, say you're going to play a slow fox rock. That's slow. Right? Somebody may want a slow number. Somebody may want a fast number. Well you play a fast number. Somebody may want a waltz. They're waltz. Same thing, you know what I mean? You know how wars be supposed to be played, you know how soul numbers are supposed to be played, you know how fast numbers are supposed to be played. You know what I mean? Yeah, you see? But the thing about it when you play for a dance band, you get more of a kick…
